_what: The Workspace screen: an overview (the workspace's picture and name, and the account it belongs to), the summary templates (the stock ones and the person's own), the person's profile details (birthday, location, and a link to the one account-deletion flow) and a Members table with an invite-by-email form. `fact` is where the name, picture (the identity of a picture file the person keeps), birthday and location are kept (one account fact). The summary templates are the stock ones (src/workspace/meeting-review.json summary_tools) and the person's own, kept as snippets under that file's `own_tag` (src/snippets.mjs), the same ones the note review's template picker offers. The overview's Switch opens a panel listing the person's pursuits, each opened by its own address (`open_address`, built by the caller from the pursuit's id). Every word is here. The Members table lists everyone who shares a pursuit with the person, by the name each shows there, and the pursuits they share; an invite goes into the pursuit the person picks, the same invitation Spaces sends. `account_page` is the Settings rail item (src/workspace/settings-panels.json) the account link switches to in place.
